clue.text: Jan Leeming met disheartened, gnarled old boxer

indicators.note: gnarled means twisted and knotted, so the letters before it are twisted into a new order

clue.text: Get to grips with Elgar for solving over two pages

clue.text: After forty winks, start to exercise the back of the neck

clue.text: Propose suppressing noise when taken up residence

clue.text: A politician getting invited to clear off, being something of a wash-out
